name: Django blog backend
description: Django settings and views with debug on, a hard-coded secret key and database password, MD5 password hashing, SQL built by string formatting, weak random tokens and a shell command. Intentionally insecure, for education.
expected: Findings across two files, including settings that look like configuration but are real secrets.

fixes.title: Read secrets from the environment
fixes.explanation: The Django secret key and the database password come from environment variables (rotate the exposed values).

fixes.title: Turn DEBUG off
fixes.explanation: DEBUG must be off in production.

fixes.title: Hash passwords with salted scrypt
fixes.explanation: A salted, memory-hard hash replaces unsalted MD5.
edits:
salt = os.urandom(16)
    return salt.hex() + ":" + hashlib.scrypt(raw.encode(), salt=salt, n=2**14, r=8, p=1).hex()

fixes.title: Bind the author as a query parameter
fixes.explanation: The driver substitutes the value safely.
edits: cur.execute("SELECT * FROM posts WHERE author = '%s'" % author)

fixes.title: Use the secrets module for tokens
fixes.explanation: secrets draws from the operating system's cryptographic generator.

fixes.title: Call convert with an argument list
fixes.explanation: No shell is involved, so the file name cannot inject commands.
